Name: Jehozabad, Son of Shomer
Summary: Jehozabad, son of Shomer, with Jozachar, conspired and slew King Joash in the house of Millo.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Shomer, Mother of Jehozabad; Jozachar, Son of Shimeath
LifeLesson: Conspiracy in the household ends a reign that idolatry had already emptied.
